description.zh: 直播流应用名称。输入的AppName必须与需要转推的直播流AppName保持一致，方可生效。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
description.en: The name of the application. The value must be the same as that of the live stream that you want to relay. View AppName on the [Stream Management](t2019924.xdita#).

description.zh: 转推的第三方直播地址。
description.en: The third-party URL to which the live stream is relayed.

description.zh: 直播流名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看StreamName。
description.en: The name of the live stream. View StreamName on the [Stream Management](t2019924.xdita#) page.

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-center-transfer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name testapp --stream-name teststream --dst-url rtmp://push.example2.aliyundoc.com/testapp1/teststream2 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveCenterTransfer --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName teststream --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DstUrl 'rtmp://push.example2.aliyundoc.com/testapp1/teststream2' --AppName testapp
